name: Images
description: Provider-routed image generation, editing, import, export, prompt routing, and platform surface profiles

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key used by the images plugin for GPT Image and Responses image-generation routes.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key used by the images plugin for Gemini image generation.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Alternative Google AI API key environment variable for Gemini image generation.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_images_recommend
execTools.summary: Recommend an image provider, model, surface, dimensions, and quality tier
execTools.description: Recommend a deterministic image provider, model, surface profile, dimensions, and quality tier for an image generation request.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_images_generate
execTools.summary: Generate an image through a configured native provider adapter
execTools.description: Generate an image through a configured native image provider adapter, save it into Assets, and return the canonical image filename.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_images_import
execTools.summary: Import an existing local image file into Assets
execTools.description: Import an existing local image file into the Assets pipeline and return the canonical image filename.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_images_export

execTools.description: Export an existing image asset to a target surface profile by resizing, cropping, and format-converting it.

execTools.description: Edit an existing image asset through a configured image provider. This tool is reserved for provider edit adapters.
